text: The original Account Hub landing imported utility members as module exports. Its follow-up fixes the import to destructure AccountCreationUtils first. Accepted email code and the utility module still agree on that nested export shape, although the members changed. When importing this module, use its actual exported namespace rather than assuming a named function is a direct export. This is a scoped JavaScript import pattern, not a general preference for nested objects. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or live accessibility validation was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Import AccountCreationUtils members from its exported object
